title: JsonField
description: Strict-JSON textarea with a format button and accessible syntax feedback; formatting preserves numbers, escapes and key order.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Syntax feedback is withheld while typing and checked on blur; the button re-indents valid JSON.

indent.title: Indentation and toolbar
indent.description: indent sets the spaces per level (0 compacts); hideToolbar removes the button but keeps the feedback.

form-control.title: With FormField
form-control.description: Disabled, read-only and required states are inherited from the field.

JsonFieldProps.value: JSON text (controlled); omit for an uncontrolled field
JsonFieldProps.defaultValue: Initial text of an uncontrolled field
JsonFieldProps.onChange: Called with the new text on every edit and after formatting
JsonFieldProps.hideToolbar: Hides the format button; syntax feedback stays visible and associated
JsonFieldProps.indent: Spaces per indentation level when formatting (0 to 10; 0 compacts the JSON)
JsonFieldProps.formatLabel: Accessible label of the format button
JsonFieldProps.invalidLabel: Status text prefix for invalid JSON (followed by the parser error)
JsonFieldProps.className: Class name of the outer wrapper

cssVars.--json-field-gap: Space between the toolbar, the editor and the status line
cssVars.--json-field-font-family: Font family of the editor (defaults to the monospace stack)
cssVars.--json-field-tab-size: Rendered width of a tab character in the editor
cssVars.--json-field-status-font-size: Font size of the validation status line

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Initial JSON from the value attribute. The status line appears on blur; minerva-change fires on blur and after formatting, and validity reflects the syntax.

options.title: Indent, toolbar and labels
options.description: indent="4" with formatValue() called from an external button, a read-only field without toolbar, and custom format / status labels.

form.title: In a form
form.description: Invalid JSON is badInput (also while focused), so the form cannot be submitted until the text parses; fix the payload to send it. Reset restores the value attribute.

props.invalid: Error state; also set by a syntax error after blur.
props.readOnly: Read-only: focusable and submitted, neither editable nor formattable.
props.placeholder: Placeholder text shown while the field is empty.
props.name: Name under which the value is submitted with the form.
props.disabled: Disables the control: not focusable, not submitted, not validated.
props.required: The control must have a value for the form to be submitted.
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).

events.change: The text was committed (blur) or formatted.
events.minerva-input: The text changed by typing or formatting; detail: { value }.
events.minerva-change: The text was committed (blur) or formatted; detail: { value }.

cssVars.--icon-button-color: Icon color of the inner icon buttons.
cssVars.--icon-button-hover-bg: Background of the inner icon buttons on hover.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of a pressed inner icon button.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-bg: Background of a pressed inner icon button.
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the inner icon buttons (defaults follow the density's control heights).
cssVars.--icon-button-icon-size: Font size of the icons of the inner icon buttons.
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the inner icon buttons (defaults to --radius-lg).
cssVars.--textarea-min-height: Minimum height of the text area.
cssVars.--textarea-padding-x: Horizontal padding of the text (defaults to the density's small control padding).
cssVars.--textarea-radius: Corner radius of the text area (defaults to --radius-md).
cssVars.--textarea-background: Background color of the text area.
cssVars.--textarea-border-color: Border color of the text area at rest.

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner control.
methods.formatValue: Re-indents the text with indent spaces (no-op unless it is valid JSON); does not emit events.
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).
